description: Installation of a multifunctional communication hub including defibrillator and internally illuminated digital advertisement display
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed communication hub, by reason of its size, scale, siting and appearance, would result in an obtrusive and visually incongruous feature that contributes to an unsightly proliferation and clutter of signage and street furniture in the local area that would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D4 (Delivering Good Design),&nbsp; D8 (Public Realm), HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP1 (High Quality Design), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP7 (Advertisements) of Hackney's Local Development Plan (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed advertisement, by reason of its size, scale, appearance, location and method of illumination, would result in an obstructive and intrusive form of development that would obstruct the pavement, reduce the amount of space available for use by pedestrians, block lines of sight, create blind spots and create distractions for highway users, reducing the safety of the highway.&nbsp; As such, the proposed development is contrary to policy D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan (2021) as well as policy PP1 (Public Realm), LP7 (Advertisements), LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods) and LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</p>
